version_note: Front page, 'Before Chaos', posted 21 June 2011: 'This site is archived directly from our GMS database ... with its Big Bang updates and changes.' It is post-Big-Bang GMS (v0.96 era), a different game version from MapleStory Classic World (MeowDB). Its stats differ from MeowDB's (Snail HP 15 here, 45 on MeowDB).
method: manual page views in a normal browser (T3 preview tab) after the project owner passed the Cloudflare check; rendered page text, trimmed to the record
